SELECT -- 期间总入账：从资金流水表 (u_account_log) 统计充值类型 (type=1) 的金额 (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM u_account_log WHERE type = 1 AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) AS totalRevenue,
-- 今日新增充值：限制日期为 CURDATE() (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) FROM u_account_log WHERE type = 1 AND DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()) AS todayRevenue,
-- 红包流水总额：直接统计红包主表 (u_red_packet) 中发出的红包总额 (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM u_red_packet WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) AS redPacketTotal,
-- AI算力消耗预估：假设未来你在流水表中加入 type=4 代表AI算力扣除 -- 注意：由于扣费金额是负数，这里使用 ABS() 取绝对值以便在前端展示正数 (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ABS(amount)), 0) FROM u_account_log WHERE type = 4 AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}) AS aiCostTotal

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM u_account_log WHERE type = 1 -- 只统计 type=1 (充值) AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT CASE type WHEN 2 THEN '发出红包' WHEN 4 THEN 'AI大模型算力' ELSE '其他支出' END AS type, -- Echarts 饼图需要正数值，而表里的支出是负数（如发红包的 -10.00），所以用 ABS 取绝对值 SUM(ABS(amount)) AS amount FROM u_account_log WHERE amount < 0 -- 重点：只统计出账流水（金额小于0的记录） AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY type
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM recharge_order WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY status

WITH dates AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM u_red_packet WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} UNION SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date FROM u_red_packet_record WHERE DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) SELECT d.date, IFNULL(s.sentAmount, 0) AS sentAmount, IFNULL(r.receivedAmount, 0) AS receivedAmount FROM dates d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(total_amount) AS sentAmount FROM u_red_packet GROUP BY date ) s ON d.date = s.date LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(amount) AS receivedAmount FROM u_red_packet_record GROUP BY date ) r ON d.date = r.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
SELECT u.user_name AS userName, a.balance FROM u_account a LEFT JOIN user u ON a.user_id = u.id ORDER BY a.balance DESC LIMIT 10
